newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Suez Nederland ups Hunter Douglas to Buy.
newsitem.headline: Suez Nederland ups Hunter Douglas to Buy.

text.p: Summary of October research. Company---------Sector--------Price------------Broker--------- Hunter Douglas dom applics 119.50 Suez Nederland

New record earnings at window blinds maker's just matter of time. Because of reorganisations, strong market position and reasonable economic circumstances, 1996 earnings will exceed previous record level posted in 1989. For coming years further turnover and profit growth expected, in particular in Far East and North America, and operational margins could improve further. Chart pattern is positive.
